description: WRITE: create/register a new customer in Amberflo (id + name required; optional email, enabled flag, and traits). Optionally auto-create the customer in Stripe. API: POST /customers/.

create_in_stripe.description: When true, also auto-create this customer in Stripe (adds ?autoCreateCustomerInStripe=true).

customer_id.description: Unique customerId to assign (your identifier for the customer).

name: amberflo_create_customer
title: Create customer
